name: Fuzzbucket
original_description:
Fuzzbucket is a brand-aware creative workspace for marketing content. With Fuzzbucket in ChatGPT you can work inside your own Fuzzbucket account: pick a brand and its context, open or create a workspace, draft image, video, audio, text and post nodes on the canvas, brief the workspace's creative assistant, start generation with the models available on your plan, follow progress, and preview or download the results.

Tools that only read your data are separate from tools that change it or start generation, so ChatGPT can ask before anything changes. Generation works exactly as in the Fuzzbucket app and uses your existing Fuzzbucket plan.

You need a Fuzzbucket account. When you connect, you choose the access level (read only, create and edit, or full access) and which brands ChatGPT can use, and you can disconnect at any time in Fuzzbucket Settings > MCP.
